method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 她指出照片里的野马轿车在现实中是午夜蓝色。
facts.anchor: The Mustang is black and white in the photo, but in life it was blue. Midnight blue.

facts.fact: 这辆车是他父亲在他提前大学毕业时送的礼物。
facts.anchor: The car was an early college graduation present from his father

facts.fact: 她指着右侧挡泥板上的凹痕和掉漆让Tommy看。
facts.anchor: See that dent and the missing paint?

facts.fact: 她说车牌吻合，并从旧照片里找到一张两人站在车旁的照片。
facts.anchor: the plates match. I went back through my old pictures and found one of the two of you standing beside it.

facts.fact: 她推测Eeling让Ramsby利用他在金斯敦警察局的关系拿到这些照片。
facts.anchor: I’m guessing Eeling asked Ramsby to use his contacts at the police station in Kingston to get these.

facts.fact: 她说Ramsby死后让人把这些照片寄了出来。
facts.anchor: Then Ramsby had them mailed after he died.

facts.fact: Tommy说这些单凭一点不足以起诉他，更不足以推翻定罪，缺少硬证据。
facts.anchor: No judge or jury would indict him on this alone, much less overturn my conviction. Not without hard evidence.

facts.fact: 她说现在他们知道是谁害了Tommy。
facts.anchor: Now we know who did this to you.

facts.fact: 她说他们也知道可以信任谁。
facts.anchor: And we know who we can trust.
